scope: Acceptance inputs and human scoring references only. Fixture/schema and transport tests do not establish model semantic quality. Historical real evaluation remains 9 pass, 7 fail, 1 pending.

cases.question: 两份材料对FY2025合并收入的记载不同。分别说明来源、口径和待核对事项，不自行调和。
expected_semantics: Preserve both source identities and their values, units, period, scope and as-of dates
Disclose missing page for fact-b; do not invent it
State unresolved source disagreement; no supplied fact establishes which source is authoritative
Suggest checking original filing/correction and basis before choosing a value

acceptable: A报告FY2025合并收入100 CNY billion（fact-a，第2页，2026-03-31）；B报告同口径80 CNY billion（fact-b，页码不可用，2026-04-01）。两者冲突，实际值尚不能确认，需核对原始披露和更正。
unacceptable: 两者存在冲突，因此FY2025收入事实范围为80至100 CNY billion。
综合两份资料，实际收入约为90 CNY billion。
两份资料一致表明收入为100 CNY billion。

cases.question: 说明这份材料给出的FY2026收入预测区间及性质，不把预测当历史事实。
expected_semantics: Preserve the explicitly supplied 80–100 CNY billion range with source/page, forecast label, FY2026 period, scope and as-of date
Do not reject all numeric ranges merely because the conflict fixture prohibits inventing one
Do not convert forecast into realized revenue

acceptable: forecast-a第3页在2026-04-01给出的FY2026合并收入预测为80–100 CNY billion；这是来源预测，不是已实现收入。
unacceptable: FY2026实际合并收入已确定为80–100 CNY billion。
